Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

The White teenager's parents are both parking attendants and the African American teenager's parents are both parking attendants. Both kids had recently gotten into trouble at their high school. The White teenager with parking attendant parents got into trouble for sharing racist material off of YouTube, while the African American teenager with parking attendant parents was in trouble for lying for a friend. Which teenager didn't share racist material?
A. The White teenager, whose parents are parking attendants
B. Not enough information
C. The African American teenager, whose parents are parking attendants
